metadata.research_method: WebSearch (~36 queries) + WebFetch (4 attempts, mostly redirected by Tripadvisor anti-scrape) — all picks cross-verified on Booking.com / MakeMyTrip / Gujarat Tourism (gujarattourism.com) / official property sites / Tripadvisor

existing.name: The House of MG
existing.issue: OK — real heritage hotel, world-class anchor

replacement.name: The House of MG
replacement.tagline: 1924 textile-magnate mansion restored as 38-room heritage hotel opposite the Sidi Saiyad mosque jali screens, in India's first UNESCO Heritage City. Agashiye on the rooftop serves bronzeware Gujarati thalis nightly.
replacement.address: Opp. Sidi Saiyad Jali, Lal Darwaja, Bhadra, Ahmedabad 380001, Gujarat

existing.name: Hyatt Regency Ahmedabad
existing.issue: OK — real, Sabarmati riverfront, 2 sources already

replacement.name: Hyatt Regency Ahmedabad
replacement.tagline: 17/A Ashram Road, 300m from the Sabarmati Riverfront and 10 min from the Gandhi Ashram — the central 5-star for combining old-city pol walks with airport transfers. China House and Tinello drive the dining repertoire.
replacement.address: 17/A, Ashram Road, Usmanpura, Ahmedabad 380014, Gujarat

existing.name: Hotel Treebo Trend Aroma
existing.issue: Treebo is a budget-aggregator chain — properties under this label rotate and the specific 'Aroma' branch is no longer listed on Treebo's Ahmedabad page. Replacing with a more durable value pick.

replacement.name: Sarovar Portico Kalupur
replacement.tagline: Five minutes walk from Kalupur Junction with old-city heritage views — a vegetarian Sarovar property aimed at train arrivals and Sabarmati Ashram day-trippers. Ranked Travellers' Choice and the most reliably-priced mid-range hotel in the walled-city ring.
replacement.address: Kalupur Railway Station Road, Ahmedabad 380002, Gujarat

existing.name: Mangaldas Ni Haveli I
existing.issue: OK — real 300-year-old haveli, 2-suite intimate stay run by House of MG group

replacement.name: Mangaldas Ni Haveli I by The House of MG
replacement.tagline: Two-suite 300-year-old haveli with carved wooden columns deep inside Khadia pol — the most intimate heritage stay in Ahmedabad's UNESCO precinct, managed by the House of MG team. Mangaldas II next door adds 6 more rooms.
replacement.address: Khadia, Old City, Ahmedabad 380001, Gujarat

existing.name: Ambaji Resort
existing.issue: Generic placeholder — no property by this exact name verifiable on Booking/MMT/Gujarat Tourism. Replacing with Vinti Resort, the established temple-adjacent resort.

replacement.name: Vinti Resort
replacement.tagline: Resort with pool and lawn near Ambaji and Kailash Tekari temples, designed for pilgrim families staying overnight before the Gabbar Hill darshan. Rooms and villas, on-site veg restaurant — the most modern stay in the temple town.
replacement.address: Kailash Tekri Road, Ambaji 385110, Banaskantha, Gujarat

existing.name: Shree Hari Guesthouse
existing.issue: Common placeholder name across temple-town listings; no verified single property in Ambaji. Replacing with the Lords Eco Inn — a real budget-mid chain property listed on Lords Hotels site.

replacement.name: Lords Eco Inn Ambaji
replacement.tagline: Lords Hotels' budget vegetarian property in the temple lane, with parking, lift, AC rooms — the cleanest value sleep within 1 km of Ambaji Mata's darshan queue.
replacement.address: Near Ambaji Temple, Ambaji 385110, Banaskantha, Gujarat

existing.name: Gayatri Guest House
existing.issue: Generic name with zero verifiable footprint. Replacing with Pride Resort Ambaji — confirmed via Pride Hotels' chain site.

replacement.name: Pride Resort Ambaji
replacement.tagline: Pride Hotels' Ambaji resort with banquet, pool and parking on the Ambaji–Abu Road link — broadest family rooms and the easiest spot to base a Mount Abu day-trip from the Gujarat side.
replacement.address: Ambaji–Abu Road Highway, Ambaji 385110, Banaskantha, Gujarat

existing.name: Bhojan Shala Yatri Niwas (Ambaji Trust)
existing.issue: OK — real temple-trust dharamshala. Refining name to match official trust phrasing.

replacement.name: Shakti Pathikashram (Arasuri Ambaji Mata Devasthan Trust)
replacement.tagline: Trust-run pathikashram 1 km from the temple, two/three/four/seven-bedded AC and non-AC rooms with attached toilets and hot water, plus cottages and a 10-bedded dorm — built for pilgrim families and bhojanalay meals through the day.
replacement.address: Near Ambaji Bus Stand, Ambaji 385110, Banaskantha, Gujarat

existing.name: Nilambag Palace Hotel
existing.issue: OK — real heritage palace of the Gohil dynasty, run as hotel since the 1980s. Confidence 0.95 deserved.

replacement.name: Nilambag Palace Hotel
replacement.tagline: 1859 Gohil-dynasty palace converted to hotel in the 1980s — tennis court, outdoor pool and a tree-lined garden 2 km from Bhavnagar railway station. Adults-only, only 26 rooms, the genuine heritage anchor of Saurashtra.
replacement.address: Nilambag Circle, Bhavnagar 364002, Gujarat

existing.name: The Fern Residency Bhavnagar
existing.issue: Real Fern Residency property (Concept Hospitality). Confidence 0.82 is correct.

replacement.name: The Fern Residency Bhavnagar
replacement.tagline: Eco-friendly Fern brand 4-star with pool and gym 3 km from the airport — the most consistent mid-range business stay in the city and the easiest jump-off point for a Velavadar or Palitana day-trip.
replacement.address: Plot No 49, Sardarnagar, Bhavnagar 364001, Gujarat

existing.name: Oasis Hotel & Restaurant
existing.issue: Common Indian-roadside name; no specific verifiable Bhavnagar Oasis hotel. Replacing with Hotel Sun-N-Shine, a verified mid-range central option.

replacement.name: Hotel Sun-N-Shine
replacement.tagline: Centrally located hotel on Waghawadi Road near Takhteshwar Mandir — restaurant, AC rooms, parking — the most reliable central pick for a single-night stop before driving south to Palitana.
replacement.address: Waghawadi Road, Bhavnagar 364001, Gujarat

existing.name: Gaurang Villa Homestay
existing.issue: No verifiable footprint on Booking/MMT/Tripadvisor under this exact name. Replacing with the Blackbuck Lodge — within Velavadar/Bhavnagar district reach and Bhavnagar's signature wildlife xfactor.

replacement.name: The Blackbuck Lodge
replacement.tagline: Ultra-luxe 14-cottage lodge inside the golden Velavadar grasslands, 65 km from Bhavnagar — open jeeps with naturalist guides, plunge-pool cottages, and a winter harrier roost on the doorstep. The reason wildlife travellers fly into Bhavnagar at all.
replacement.address: Hingolgadh, Adhelai Village, Velavadar, Bhavnagar District 364313, Gujarat

existing.name: The Mada Mada Heritage Resort
existing.issue: Template-ghost — no property by this name on Booking/MMT/Gujarat Tourism. Champaner has exactly one heritage anchor.

replacement.name: Champaner Heritage Resort
replacement.tagline: Restored Bhamaria–Sonipur princely palace on 40 acres of 2,700 mango orchard trees, surrounded by Dev Dam reservoir and Pavagadh hill — 12 km from the UNESCO Champaner archaeological park, two pools and kayaking on site.
replacement.address: Village Bhamaria, Champaner–Jambughoda Road, Halol Taluka, Panchmahal District 389350, Gujarat

existing.name: Hotel Champaner Inn
existing.issue: Template ghost — no property by this name listed. Halol town has limited stays; closest verified mid-range is the Vikrama Heritage Resort or budget Halol-town options.

replacement.name: Vikrama Heritage Resort
replacement.tagline: 60-room resort on the Halol–Pavagadh road run by Vikram Pratap Singh of Sankheda — pool, restaurant, banquet — the only modern mid-range stay between Vadodara and the UNESCO park.
replacement.address: Halol–Pavagadh Road, near Pavagadh foothill, Panchmahal 389350, Gujarat

existing.name: The Pavilion Boutique Hotel
existing.issue: Generic template ghost — no boutique hotel called 'The Pavilion' exists in or near Champaner-Pavagadh. Honest scarcity: location-of-attraction stays are very thin; the heritage resort and Vikrama already cover the closest options.

existing.name: Champaner Heritage Resort (Orchards stay)
existing.issue: Duplicates the experience slot when we promoted it there. Replacing xfactor with the Vadodara Welcomhotel base — the only luxury bed within 60 min of Champaner.

replacement.name: WelcomHotel by ITC Hotels Vadodara
replacement.tagline: ITC's flagship 5-star on R.C. Dutt Road in Alkapuri, 1 hr by car from the Champaner Pavagadh UNESCO complex — the only luxury bed within striking distance and the favourite night-after stop for travellers combining Vadodara museums with the Pavagadh climb.
replacement.address: R. C. Dutt Road, Alkapuri, Vadodara 390007, Gujarat

existing.name: Shri Krishna Guesthouse
existing.issue: Generic temple-town template name with no verifiable footprint. Real Dakor lodgings are trust-run dharamshalas listed via yatradham/temple trust.

replacement.name: Shri Trikamji Mandir Yatrik Nivas
replacement.tagline: Two-bedded AC and 2/3/4-bedded non-AC rooms inside the Trikamji Mandir compound — closest pilgrim sleep to the Ranchhodraiji darshan and a 5-minute walk to the morning Sharad Purnima crowds.
replacement.address: Near Ranchhodraiji Temple, Dakor 388225, Kheda District, Gujarat

existing.name: Madhav Temple Gate Hotel
existing.issue: No verifiable footprint under this exact name. Replacing with the listed Bharat Bhavan Ashram which is genuinely temple-gate-adjacent.

replacement.name: Bharat Bhavan Ashram
replacement.tagline: Ashram dharamshala roughly 300m from the Ranchhodraiji temple gate — basic AC and non-AC rooms, food facility, hot water — the most reliably-priced bed within darshan-bell range.
replacement.address: Near Ranchhodraiji Temple, Dakor 388225, Kheda District, Gujarat

existing.name: Ranchhodraiji Temple Yatri Niwas
existing.issue: Real — trust-managed yatri nivas. Refining naming to match its actual listing.

replacement.name: Shree Ranchhodraiji Mandir Yatri Niwas
replacement.tagline: Temple-trust managed pilgrim bhavan beside the Ranchhodraiji shrine — the only stay that sits literally on the parikrama route. Built for Punam (full-moon) pilgrim surges; book early during Sharad Purnima.
replacement.address: Shree Ranchhodraiji Temple Compound, Dakor 388225, Kheda District, Gujarat

existing.name: Hotel Vrindavan Dakor
existing.issue: Real budget hotel; verified on yatradham/Hotels.com.

replacement.name: Hotel Vrindavan
replacement.tagline: The closest mid-range to the Dakor temple square with private bathrooms, AC and a vegetarian thali restaurant — used by Vaishnav families on extended dharma yatras combining Dakor with Nathdwara.
replacement.address: Near Ranchhodraiji Temple, Dakor 388225, Kheda District, Gujarat

existing.name: Rann Resort Dholavira
existing.issue: Real — on Khavda Road near excavation site

replacement.name: Rann Resort Dholavira
replacement.tagline: Mid-range bhunga-style cottage cluster on Khavda Road 3 km from the Harappan excavation gate — the most central bookable stay on Khadir Bet and the closest sunrise base for first-light walks through the ruins.
replacement.address: Khavda Road, Dholavira 370165, Kutch District, Gujarat

existing.name: Praveg Dholavira Tent City
existing.issue: Real — 30 triangle A-frame cottages, glass-roof stargazing

replacement.name: Praveg Resort Dholavira
replacement.tagline: Thirty 20-foot-tall triangle 'A'-frame cottages with full-glass walls for in-bed Rann stargazing, on the Dholavira–Flamingo Lake stretch — Praveg's headline build outside the Dhordo Tent City circuit. Open mid-October to March only.
replacement.address: Near World Heritage Site, towards Flamingo Lake, Dholavira, Bhachau Taluka, Kutch District 370165, Gujarat

existing.name: Evoke Dholavira
existing.issue: Real — 44-cottage luxury property on Khadir Bet

replacement.name: Evoke Dholavira
replacement.tagline: 44 aesthetically-appointed cottages on Khadir Bet inside Rann landscape — the highest-end built lodging at Dholavira, 125 km from Bhuj via the elevated Road Through Heaven. Open seasonally October–March.
replacement.address: Khadir Bet Island, Dholavira 370165, Kutch District, Gujarat

existing.name: Rann Resort Dholavira
existing.issue: Duplicate of the location pick. Replacing the value slot with the homestay/budget alternative on Khadir Bet.

replacement.name: Khadir Homestay Resort
replacement.tagline: Family-run village homestay near Dholavira excavation site — the budget bed of choice for solo and student travellers who want Kutchi hospitality rather than a tented resort. Open seasonally.
replacement.address: Khadir Bet, Dholavira 370165, Kutch District, Gujarat

existing.name: Rajhans Hotel
existing.issue: Rajhans Hotel chain operates in Mumbai, Haryana, and Bhopal — NOT in Dwarka. Pure cross-state contamination / template ghost. Replacing with Hawthorn Suites by Wyndham (verified).

replacement.name: Hawthorn Suites by Wyndham Dwarka
replacement.tagline: Wyndham extended-stay suites with kitchenettes and pool a few minutes from the Dwarkadhish temple gate and Gomti Ghat — the easiest international-chain bed in a temple town otherwise dominated by budget pilgrim hotels.
replacement.address: Devbhumi Dwarka, Dwarka 361335, Gujarat

existing.name: Hotel The Grand Dwarka
existing.issue: 'The Grand Dwarka' has no verifiable single-property footprint — 'The Grand Ladhukara' exists but is not the same brand. Replacing with Lemon Tree Premier Dwarka — the verifiable premium temple-view stay.

replacement.name: Lemon Tree Premier Dwarka
replacement.tagline: 109-room Lemon Tree Premier with rooftop pool and temple-view rooms 790m from the Dwarkadhish shrine — the only luxury option with a true Jagat Mandir balcony view at sunset aarti.
replacement.address: Ghanshyam Nagar, Dwarka 361335, Gujarat

existing.name: Toran Tourist Bungalow (GTDC)
existing.issue: Real Gujarat Tourism GTDC property near Chowpati and the temple.

replacement.name: GTDC Toran Tourist Bungalow Dwarka
replacement.tagline: 24-room Gujarat Tourism (GTDC) bungalow on Chowpati near Circuit House, walking distance to the Dwarkadhish temple and to the beach — the most affordable bed that still books online via the state portal.
replacement.address: Chowpati, near Circuit House, Jori Bagh Main Road, Dwarka 361335, Gujarat

existing.name: Hotel Shree Hari Dwarka
existing.issue: Real — has own site, listed on Hotels.com

replacement.name: Hotel Shree Hari Dwarka
replacement.tagline: Vegetarian mid-range hotel close to the temple lane — ranked highly with pilgrim families for vegetarian breakfast and proximity to both Dwarkadhish darshan and the Sudama Setu pedestrian bridge.
replacement.address: Near Dwarkadhish Temple, Dwarka 361335, Gujarat

existing.name: Hotel Surya Palace
existing.issue: Hotel Surya Palace is in Vadodara, NOT Gandhinagar — cross-dest contamination. Replacing with Fortune Inn Haveli, the central Sector-11 ITC option.

replacement.name: Fortune Inn Haveli Gandhinagar
replacement.tagline: ITC Fortune business hotel right opposite the State Secretariat in Sector 11, 20 min from SVPI Airport and 3 km from Gandhinagar railway — the closest hotel for visitors heading to Akshardham temple and Mahatma Mandir.
replacement.address: Sector 11, Opposite Secretariat, Gandhinagar 382010, Gujarat

existing.name: Cambay Sapphire Resort
existing.issue: Real Cambay Hotels property in GIDC Sector 25 — 199 rooms

replacement.name: Cambay Sapphire Gandhinagar
replacement.tagline: 199-room Cambay resort with villas, cottages, pool and banquet lawns in GIDC Sector 25 — Gujarat's go-to convention venue and the largest spread of grass within the capital ring road.
replacement.address: Plot No 22, 23 & 24, GIDC, Sector 25, Gandhinagar 382044, Gujarat

existing.name: Fortune Inn Haveli (ITC group)
existing.issue: Promoted to the location slot above (because it's the best-located, not the best value). Replacing value with a more genuinely budget pick.

replacement.name: Lemon Tree Hotel Gandhinagar
replacement.tagline: Lemon Tree's Gandhinagar property near Infocity and Mahatma Mandir — pool, gym, predictable 4-star service at the cheapest end of the corporate mid-range stack, ideal for solo work-trips around GIFT City.
replacement.address: Infocity, Gandhinagar 382009, Gujarat

existing.name: Leela Gandhinagar (at GIFT City)
existing.issue: Real — The Leela Gandhinagar sits literally above Gandhinagar railway station / Mahatma Mandir.

replacement.name: The Leela Gandhinagar
replacement.tagline: First luxury hotel in India built directly above a railway station (Gandhinagar Capital), 1.2 mi from Mahatma Mandir — Leela's regional flagship with the rooftop pool and Spectra ballroom that anchors capital-city events.
replacement.address: Gandhinagar Railway Station Complex, Sector 14, Gandhinagar 382016, Gujarat

existing.name: Sinh Sadan
existing.issue: Real — Gujarat Forest Dept hunting-lodge guest house since 1911 at Sasan Gir gate.

replacement.name: Sinh Sadan Forest Guest House
replacement.tagline: 1911 Forest Department hunting-lodge guest house literally at the Sasan Gir National Park entrance, 5 min walk from Sasan railway station — the cheapest legal stay for early-morning permit pickups and post-safari lion-roar lulls.
replacement.address: Sasan Gir, Junagadh District 362135, Gujarat

existing.name: Aramness Gir National Park
existing.issue: Real — 18 kothi suites, boutique safari lodge

replacement.name: Aramness Gir National Park
replacement.tagline: 18-kothi luxury safari lodge bordering Sasan Gir's teak forest — each kothi has a private courtyard and verandah, with the only twice-daily game-drive access to the lion sanctuary on this side of the park. Closed mid-June to mid-October.
replacement.address: Haripur, Sasan Gir, Junagadh District 362135, Gujarat

existing.name: Asiatic Lion Lodge
existing.issue: Real — 16 deluxe cottages between Gir hills near Haripur

replacement.name: Asiatic Lion Lodge
replacement.tagline: 16-cottage eco-lodge between two forested hills of Gir adjoining a natural pond near Haripur village — Kathiawadi hospitality at half the Aramness price tag, used by serious birders and small safari groups.
replacement.address: Haripur Village, Sasan Gir, Junagadh District 362135, Gujarat

existing.name: The Fern Gir Forest Resort
existing.issue: Real Fern brand resort at Gir.

replacement.name: The Fern Gir Forest Resort
replacement.tagline: Fern Hotels' eco-friendly resort 6 km from Sasan Gir gate — pool, multi-cuisine veg restaurant, easy jeep pickup — the most consistent mid-range bed for families doing two safaris over a weekend.
replacement.address: Sasan Gir–Talala Road, Sasan Gir, Junagadh District 362150, Gujarat

existing.name: Hotel Krishna Palace, Junagadh
existing.issue: Junagadh, not Girnar specifically — Girnar pilgrimage stays should ideally be Bhavnath taleti / temple base. Replacing with Hotel Asopalav (verified Bhavnath property).

replacement.name: Hotel Asopalav Bhavnath
replacement.tagline: Mid-range hotel at Bhavnath taleti — the literal foot of Girnar's 9,999-step climb — where pilgrims base before pre-dawn ascents to Amba Mata and Dattatreya peaks. Open year-round, pool, restaurant, free parking.
replacement.address: Bhavnath Road, near Girnar Ropeway, Junagadh 362001, Gujarat

existing.name: The Lotus Hotel Junagadh
existing.issue: Lotus Hotel is in Junagadh city centre, ~7 km from Bhavnath — not Girnar-base. Replacing with The Fern Leo Resort, the largest 5-star with actual Girnar-hill views.

replacement.name: The Fern Leo Resort & Club Junagadh
replacement.tagline: Fern Hotels' five-star with the largest pool deck pointing straight at Girnar's silhouette — the only modern resort with proper trekking-prep facilities for the 9,999-step Girnar climb. Tour-desk arranges 4 a.m. ropeway pickups.
replacement.address: Lal Dhori, Junagadh 362001, Gujarat

existing.name: The Fern Residency Junagadh
existing.issue: Promoted The Fern Leo to experience slot. Replacing value with Junagadh's reliable city-base Lotus Hotel — close to the Girnar ropeway road.

replacement.name: The Lotus Hotel Junagadh
replacement.tagline: Three-star city-centre hotel 220m from Junagadh railway and 1.5 km from Narsinh Mehta lake — the most reliably-rated mid-range value sleep for travellers basing in town and driving 7 km to Bhavnath for the dawn climb.
replacement.address: MG Road, Near Railway Station, Junagadh 362001, Gujarat

existing.name: Bhavnath Ashram Stays (cluster)
existing.issue: Real ashram cluster but vague. Refining to Bharati Ashram + Bhagirath Wadi which are the verified Girnar-foot dharamshala anchors.

replacement.name: Shri Bharati Ashram (Girnar Taleti)
replacement.tagline: Ashram dharamshala in a large gardened compound at Bhavnath, with AC three- and four-bedded rooms and shared kitchens — the most authentic spiritual sleep for the Girnar Mahashivratri mela crowd. Book months ahead for Shivratri.
replacement.address: Bhavnath Taleti, Girnar, Junagadh 362001, Gujarat

existing.name: Hotel Samrat
existing.issue: Generic hotel name with multiple branches across India — no clear single Junagadh property verifiable on Booking/MMT. Replacing with Hotel Magnum Inn, the actual top-rated central option.

replacement.name: Hotel Magnum Inn
replacement.tagline: 25-room boutique hotel a 2 km walk from Junagadh railway, bus station and the local market — exceptional service rating with bespoke kitchen requests, the best-located non-Fern bed for Uperkot Fort and Mahabat Maqbara walking days.
replacement.address: Sardar Bagh Road, Junagadh 362001, Gujarat

existing.name: Lemon Tree Hotel Junagadh
existing.issue: Lemon Tree Junagadh does not appear in current Lemon Tree Hotels portfolio — closest is Lemon Tree Rajkot. Replacing with The Fern Leo Resort, the actual five-star anchor.

replacement.name: The Fern Leo Resort & Club Junagadh
replacement.tagline: Junagadh's largest 5-star, the biggest banquet venue in the district and the only true resort-style stay — pool, gym, spa, full club facilities and Girnar views from the upper-floor rooms.
replacement.address: Lal Dhori, Junagadh 362001, Gujarat

existing.name: The Lotus Hotel Junagadh
existing.issue: Real — 3-star city centre

replacement.name: The Lotus Hotel Junagadh
replacement.tagline: Three-star hotel 220m from Junagadh railway with reliable rooms — the most-used mid-range base for travellers combining Uperkot, Buddhist caves and Girnar in a 36-hour visit.
replacement.address: MG Road, near Railway Station, Junagadh 362001, Gujarat

existing.name: Hotel Magnet
existing.issue: Name typo in baseline — actual property is 'Hotel Magnum Inn' (already promoted to location). Replacing xfactor with Hotel Asopalav Bhavnath — the genuine Bhavnath-taleti xfactor.

replacement.name: Hotel Asopalav Bhavnath
replacement.tagline: Mid-range hotel literally at the foot of Girnar at Bhavnath taleti — the easiest place to sleep before a pre-dawn climb when the ropeway hasn't opened yet. Pool and parking, family rooms.
replacement.address: Bhavnath Road, near Girnar Ropeway, Junagadh 362001, Gujarat

existing.name: Bhuj House Hotel
existing.issue: Real — Parsi 1894 heritage homestay.

replacement.name: The Bhuj House
replacement.tagline: 1894 Parsi courtyard house restored 2015 by the fifth-generation Bhujwala family — four ensuite rooms (Rohee's, Jafri, Agassi terrace, Bapaiji's), Parsi-Kutchi courtyard meals, Outlook Gold for 'Best Heritage Stay' 2018.
replacement.address: Opposite Camp Police Chowki, Camp Area, Bhuj 370001, Kutch District, Gujarat

existing.name: The Bhuj House
existing.issue: Duplicate of the location slot — same property. Replacing experience with Regenta Resort Bhuj — the largest experiential resort in the city.

replacement.name: Regenta Resort Bhuj by Royal Orchid
replacement.tagline: 23-acre Royal Orchid resort with sunset point, human-size chess, cricket pitch, live music — the largest experiential property in Bhuj, 4 min from Kutch Museum and 6 min from Aina Mahal.
replacement.address: Mirzapar Highway, Bhuj 370020, Kutch District, Gujarat

existing.name: Regenta Resort Bhuj
existing.issue: Promoted to experience above. Replacing value with The Fern Residency Bhuj — the cleanest mid-range veg-friendly stay in town.

replacement.name: The Fern Residency Bhuj
replacement.tagline: Fern Hotels' eco-friendly mid-range hotel with pool — the cleanest pure-vegetarian business hotel in Bhuj, used by most package-tour Rann Utsav routings before the desert drive.
replacement.address: Mirzapar Highway, Bhuj 370001, Kutch District, Gujarat

existing.name: Hodka Shaam-e-Sarhad Village Resort
existing.issue: Real — UNDP-Government Endogenous Tourism project run by Hodka village committee.

replacement.name: Shaam-e-Sarhad Village Resort, Hodka
replacement.tagline: 12 bhungas (Banni-region grass-thatch mud huts) on the edge of Asia's second-largest grassland, owned and run by the Halepotra Maldhari community of Hodka village — UNDP-Government endogenous tourism since 2005. Open only October–March.
replacement.address: Hodka Village, Banni Grasslands, Bhuj Taluka 370510, Kutch District, Gujarat

existing.name: The Fern Residency, Ahmedabad
existing.issue: Cross-dest contamination — 80 km from Lothal. Replacing with Hazur Palace Utelia, which is 6 km from Lothal and the only true Lothal-area heritage stay.

replacement.name: The Palace Utelia (Hazur Palace)
replacement.tagline: Late-19th-century Indo-Saracenic palace with domes and courtyard gardens 6 km from the Lothal Harappan port site, run by descendants of the original Utelia rulers — the only heritage stay near the Indus Valley dock excavation, with cooking-class options.
replacement.address: Village Utelia, Dholka Taluka, Ahmedabad District 382260, Gujarat

existing.name: Hotel Celebration, Bhavnagar
existing.issue: Cross-dest contamination — Bhavnagar is 100+ km. Honest: there's no true 'value' bed at Lothal beyond day-trip from Ahmedabad. Replacing with Ahmedabad's value pick as the actual base.

replacement.name: Sarovar Portico Kalupur Ahmedabad
replacement.tagline: Mid-range Sarovar Portico at Kalupur Junction, 80 km north of Lothal — the most rational value bed for travellers driving south to Lothal for a half-day Harappan dock visit. Pure veg restaurant.
replacement.address: Kalupur Railway Station Road, Ahmedabad 380002, Gujarat

existing.name: Lothal Museum Guest House
existing.issue: There is no bookable 'Lothal Museum Guest House' — ASI has no overnight accommodation on site. The new National Maritime Heritage Complex (NMHC) being built is not yet operational for stays. Honest scarcity.

existing.name: Nilambag Palace, Bhavnagar
existing.issue: Cross-dest contamination — 110 km. Replacing with Palace Utelia which actually sits at Lothal, deduplicating the experience slot via the Ahmedabad-base value pick + Utelia palace.

replacement.name: House of MG Ahmedabad
replacement.tagline: If you want luxury before/after the Lothal Harappan port visit, House of MG is 75 km north in Ahmedabad's UNESCO walled city — the most distinctive heritage hotel within striking distance of the Indus Valley dock site.
replacement.address: Opp. Sidi Saiyad Jali, Lal Darwaja, Ahmedabad 380001, Gujarat

existing.name: Mandvi Beach Resort
existing.issue: Generic — no verifiable single property of this exact name. Mandvi's signature stays are inside Vijay Vilas estate or Palace Beach Camp.

replacement.name: Palace Beach Camp Mandvi
replacement.tagline: 10 VIP Swiss tents on a 25-acre private beach property inside the Vijay Vilas estate area at Mahadev Beach — the most beachfront-adjacent stay in Mandvi without crossing into the palace's heritage tariff.
replacement.address: Mahadev Beach, Vijay Vilas Road, Mandvi 370465, Kutch District, Gujarat

existing.name: The Beach at Mandvi Palace
existing.issue: Refining to actual property name — 'The Beach at Mandvi Palace' is the marketing brand for the Vijay Vilas Heritage Resort tent camp. Using the official heritage resort name.

replacement.name: Vijay Vilas Heritage Resort
replacement.tagline: Heritage rooms and garden villas inside Maharao Vijayraji's 1929 Vijay Vilas Palace estate (700 acres, including India's largest private beach) — the only stay that lets you walk straight from your room to the palace courtyards used in Lagaan and Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam.
replacement.address: Vijay Vilas Palace Estate, Mandvi 370465, Kutch District, Gujarat

existing.name: Sea View Hotel Mandvi
existing.issue: Generic name; multiple unrelated hotels carry it. Replacing with Rukmavati Guest House which is verifiable and Mandvi-specific.

replacement.name: Rukmavati Guest House
replacement.tagline: Family-run guest house near the Rukmavati Bridge on the way to the Mandvi shipbuilding yard — basic AC rooms with the easiest morning walk to the wooden dhow-building workshops, Mandvi's signature craft.
